annotations.title: Find the cheapest in a category

description: The cheapest new products of one category in Polish stores right now, optionally under a price and of one brand; products that two or more stores sell come first. The category is a Polish category name or slug, e.g. "laptopy", "karty-graficzne", "smartfony", "telewizory", "lodowki", "pralki", "odkurzacze", "sluchawki", "monitory", "perfumy", "klocki". An unknown category returns the list of categories.

max_price_pln.description: Only products sold for at most this many złoty.

name: find_cheapest_in_category
